description: arrange a first meeting with a solicitor
utterances: can i get an appointment to talk about a divorce
I'm being sued by a former business partner and have never worked with a law firm before, I'd like to sit down with someone this week to go over it.

description: move an existing appointment to another time
utterances: can we push my thursday meeting to next week
Something came up at work and I won't make the session I booked with the attorney tomorrow afternoon, is there any slot later in the week instead?

description: call off a scheduled meeting with the firm
utterances: need to cancel my appointment for friday
The dispute with my neighbour has been resolved between us so I no longer need the meeting I set up, please take it off the books.

description: whether the first meeting is charged
utterances: is the first chat free or do i pay
Before I book anything I'd like to know if the introductory session where I explain my situation comes with a charge, and if so roughly how much.

description: hold the meeting by video instead of in person
utterances: can we do the meeting over a video call
I live a few hours away from your office and it's hard for me to travel, would the lawyer be willing to meet over a screen instead?

description: check whether the firm takes on a certain kind of case
utterances: do you guys do immigration stuff at all
My landlord is trying to evict me and I'm wondering if tenancy issues are something your practice deals with or if I should look elsewhere.

description: get an update on the progress of the matter
utterances: any news on my case lately
It's been about a month since I last heard from anyone about the claim against my former employer and I'd appreciate knowing where things stand.

description: find out when the next court appearance is
utterances: when is my next hearing date
I need to request time off work for the proceedings but I've lost track of the date the judge set, could you confirm it and how long it might run?

description: the assigned lawyer has not replied to messages
utterances: my lawyer hasnt answered me in two weeks
I've left several messages and sent emails to the person handling my matter and heard nothing back, I'm starting to worry about the deadlines involved.

description: how long the matter is likely to take
utterances: roughly how long until this is all over
We've been going back and forth with the other side for months now, can someone give me a realistic sense of when this might be wrapped up?

description: come in to sign paperwork prepared by the firm
utterances: when can i come by to sign the papers
I understand the settlement agreement is ready for my signature, what days is the office open and do I need to bring anything with me?

description: sign paperwork remotely instead of visiting the office
utterances: can i just e-sign this instead of coming in
I'm abroad for the next month and the contract needs my signature before then, is there a way to do it digitally that you'll accept?

description: get a duplicate of a specific document on file
utterances: can you send me a copy of my will
I need the signed version of the lease agreement you drafted for me last year for my records, could you email it or post a certified print?

description: obtain the complete file for the matter
utterances: i want everything you have on my case
Now that the litigation is finished I'd like the full set of correspondence, filings and notes relating to it so I have my own archive.

description: hand over documents or evidence for the case
utterances: how do i get these photos to my lawyer
I've collected a stack of receipts and text message screenshots that support my side, what's the best way to pass them along securely?

description: check whether the lawyer has finished reviewing a contract
utterances: has anyone looked at the agreement i sent
I sent over the employment offer for review nine days ago and my prospective employer is pressing me to sign, is the feedback nearly ready?

description: correct a mistake in a drafted document
utterances: the draft has my birth date wrong
In the version of the trust deed you sent yesterday one of the beneficiary names is misspelled and a clause number is referenced incorrectly, please amend.

description: have a document notarized by the firm
utterances: need a stamp and signature on a form for the embassy
The overseas authority handling my property sale needs an officially witnessed and sealed power of attorney, is that something someone at your office can do?

description: understand the items on a bill
utterances: what are all these lines on my invoice
The latest statement lists a lot of short entries for phone calls and correspondence and I'd like a plain walkthrough of what each one covers.

description: challenge a charge that seems incorrect
utterances: im being billed for a meeting that never happened
My bill includes four hours of research on a day I'd specifically asked you to pause all work, I don't think I should be paying for that.

description: how the firm charges for its work
utterances: do you bill by the hour or flat rate
Before committing I'd like to understand whether I'd be paying a fixed price for the whole matter or getting charged for every call and email.

description: pay the fees in several instalments
utterances: can i pay the bill in a few chunks
The total for the custody proceedings is more than I can manage at once, would the firm agree to spread it over the next six months?

description: how much of the upfront deposit is left
utterances: how much of my retainer is still there
I put down a sum at the start of the engagement and want to know what has been drawn against it so far and when I'll need to add more.

description: get an estimate of total cost before going ahead
utterances: ballpark what will this whole thing cost me
I'm deciding whether to contest the will and need a realistic figure for what the fees might come to from start to finish, including court expenses.

description: have a different lawyer take over the case
utterances: can someone else at the firm handle my case
I don't feel the person currently working on my matter and I communicate well, I'd prefer to continue with your firm but under a different attorney.

description: report unprofessional conduct by a lawyer
utterances: i want to file a complaint about my solicitor
During our last meeting the attorney was dismissive and shared details of my situation in front of another client in the waiting area, I want this escalated.

description: stop using the firm and close the engagement
utterances: i dont want you representing me anymore
I've decided to handle the remainder of the dispute on my own, please let me know what I need to sign to formally end our arrangement.

description: have the case file forwarded to a new firm
utterances: please send my file over to my new lawyers
I've engaged a different practice to take the matter forward and they've asked for everything you hold, what do you need from me to release it to them?

description: change the contact information the firm has on file
utterances: i moved house update my details please
I've changed my mobile number and email since we started and I'm worried correspondence about the case is going to the old ones, can you fix that?

description: find out which staff are working on the matter
utterances: who exactly is handling my case now
I've received emails from three different people at your office this month and I'm confused about who is actually responsible for my file and who to contact.

description: arrange an interpreter for meetings with the lawyer
utterances: can you arrange someone to translate for me
English is my second language and I struggle with legal terms, could a professional translator be present when I come in to discuss the settlement?

description: authorize a relative to act on the client's behalf
utterances: can my daughter talk to you about my case
I'm going into hospital for surgery next month and want my brother to be able to receive updates and make decisions while I'm recovering.
